_comment: Written by the trading runs. impliedMove is a decimal or null. null means the straddle was not pulled - an open checklist item, not a placeholder to guess at. This file is a list of what is AHEAD: the pre-close run prunes catalysts once their date has passed and re-reads spot from a live quote, because a reference price carried from the day it was written makes every implied range wrong.
prunedNote: Two entries removed by the 8/6 pre-close and one added. Removed: the 8/5 earnings cluster, whose six prints are now a day behind and which the file's own 8/5 entry said the 8/6 open run would prune - it did not, so it is pruned here. Removed: the UPST time stop dated 8/11, which was the more serious staleness of the two and the kind a date check does not catch - it described a clock on 'the open position' and that position closed 8/5 at -2.84, so the row was a forecast about something the account has not held for a session. Added: the SMR 8/14 expiry, which is now the next dated thing that acts on the account. Every remaining spot is a live bid re-read at 15:36 ET, not carried from the day it was written.

moves.event: Contract expiry on the open position - final-week rule bites first
moves.source: Not an earnings event. SMR reported 8/5 and is absent from the broker earnings calendar across the whole 8/6-8/14 window - 1,517 events re-pulled live at 15:36 ET on 8/6, SMR in none of them - so nothing prints before this contract expires and hold is false because there is no print to carry into. This is the position's own clock and it belongs in the file for the same reason the UPST clock did: it is the next dated thing that acts on the account, and the board should not have to infer it from a position row. The date that binds is not 8/14 but 8/7. The rulebook says never to hold an option into its final week; 8/14 is 8 days out on 8/6 and 7 days out on 8/7, so the final week opens tomorrow morning. spot is the 15:36 ET live bid on the underlying against a 9.50 strike and a 9.99 break-even; the contract itself is 0.47 bid / 0.51 ask against a 0.57 average, delta 0.4997, theta -0.0338 a day which is 6.9% of the 0.49 mark.

branches.act: The final-week rule is being broken - it gets written down as an exception, dated, or it is not a hold
branches.why: This is the branch that is live right now and the reason the row exists. The rulebook's ban on the final week is unconditional and the position crosses into it at tomorrow's open. A rule broken with the break recorded is a decision the log can grade later; a rule broken silently is the drift the rulebook's own policy exists to catch. The pre-close cannot resolve it by publishing a spec - see the next branch - so recording it is the only form the decision can take.

branches.cond: The operator wants the exit executed
branches.act: Sell to close 2 SMR 8/14 $9.50c, limit inside the 0.47-0.51 book, raising about 98 on the 0.49 mark
branches.why: No run in this project has order authority, and the ordinary route - publish a gated specification a human executes - is closed for this class of order. scripts/validate.mjs applies the 21-day expiry floor and the limit x qty x 100 affordability charge to any spec with kind option regardless of action, so a sell-to-close is refused both for being too short-dated to buy and for costing the cash it would raise. Reproduced by running the validator against a maximally correct spec for the contract actually held: it fails on exactly those two counts and no others. So the exit reaches the operator as prose here rather than as a machine-checked spec.

branches.cond: Bid at or above 0.684 before expiry
branches.why: +20% take profit. It needs the bid up 45.5% from 0.47 and the underlying up 6.4% to a 9.99 break-even in six remaining sessions, so this is the branch that is written down to be honest about the odds rather than because it is likely.
-40% of premium, the option stop. -8% is noise on a contract. The bid would have to fall 27.2% from 0.47.

Five sessions from the 8/6 open. Checklist item 6: if nothing has happened the thesis was wrong even though the stop never hit. It is deliberately set one day before expiry so the decision is never handed to expiration day.

moves.source: Re-verified on the live broker earnings calendar at 15:36 ET on 8/6: timing 'pm', verified true, estimate -0.33, no actual yet. This is tonight's print and the only entry in this file whose date is today, which is why it survives the prune - it is still ahead at the time of writing and the 8/7 open run should remove it. spot is the live bid at 15:36 ET on 8/6, replacing the 11.40 carried from 8/5. impliedMove stays null because no straddle was pulled and none was needed: the account holds no MARA and never proposed any, so nothing is being held into this print.

branches.act: Close, or write the hold down
branches.why: Resolved to nothing. The account holds one position and it is an SMR call; there is no MARA exposure to close and no overnight decision to make on this name.

branches.act: Refused - the print is inside any five-session hold
branches.why: Resolved and closed off twice over. A hold opened today runs straight through tonight's report, and deployable settled cash is 11.98 against a 10.85 ask, so a single share is technically reachable and still fails on the print alone.

moves.source: Re-verified on the live broker earnings calendar at 15:36 ET on 8/6: timing 'am', verified true, estimate -0.16. spot is the live bid at 15:36 ET on 8/6, replacing the 43.20 carried from 8/5 - the name is 2.5% lower than the reference price this row used to carry, which is the drift this refresh exists to prevent. impliedMove is null: no straddle pulled, and none needed because nothing is held into it.

branches.why: Resolved to nothing - no OKLO is held. The branch stands for tomorrow morning's read anyway: a before-open report gaps past every stop and no run sits between the close and the print.
The last run that could act before this print is this one, and it does not open positions. At 42.13 one share is more than three times the 11.98 of deployable cash in any case.

moves.source: Re-verified on the live broker earnings calendar at 15:36 ET on 8/6: timing 'pm', verified true, estimate 0.69. Added 8/5 after the candidate list was found carrying SMCI as earnings-free. spot is the live bid at 15:36 ET on 8/6, replacing the 30.75 carried from 8/5. impliedMove stays null and that is now an open item rather than a moot one: this is the only remaining catalyst far enough ahead that an entry could still be built around it, so item 3 would have to be satisfied before any hold, not after.

branches.cond: Any entry opened on or after 8/6
branches.act: Pull the ATM straddle before sizing
branches.why: A five-session hold opened 8/6 expires about 8/13, so the 8/11 print sits inside it. Item 3 is not optional for this name: a hold through a print is a coin flip on the implied move, taken deliberately or not at all. No straddle pulled means no earnings hold.

branches.act: Close, or write the hold down with the implied move attached
branches.why: The rulebook forbids holding an option through a print outright, and an equity hold through one gets pre-decided or does not happen.
